notes.title: Argentina and Turkey local pricing
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We would like to inform you that, starting from November 20th, we do not have direct control over the pricing policy changes implemented by Steam. These changes stem from the general policies set by the platform provider, Steam.

While we may not have full responsibility for the changes in the pricing of our games, our commitment and respect for you, our valued players, will always endure. In this context, we will strive to adopt the best possible localization policies in the pricing of our upcoming games. This is aimed at making our games more accessible and ensuring a more inclusive gaming experience.

For any questions, opinions, or feedback, you can reach us at powehigame@gmail.com We are delighted to be with you and thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,

Power Games
Political Mastery

notes.title: Weekly Progress Journal 2
notes.content:
Welcome to the Political Mastery Weekly Progress Journal.

As you know, every move you make while playing Political Mastery deducts turn points. Small actions like social media posts take 1 point, while hosting a grand rally can consume all of your points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44475061/61960efcb594b465f2b53190768143349f8ad99f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44475061/6e9302d1ac08a459a444530f0b5a537dcf21b750.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44475061/172584512bd0bcccc15bf97eedefb30e94a25f91.png[/img]

To make the turn system more dynamic, we've decided to introduce a daily cycle in the game after each move. Now, in our game, after every move, the environment dynamically transitions between day and night. Who wouldn't enjoy a dynamic day-night cycle?

[previewyoutube=-o8eJiwBdRM;full][/previewyoutube]

We understand that in a game genre like ours, content is often more crucial than graphics. In this context, we'd like to discuss the game's ideological cycle in next week's development journal. We welcome your advice and opinions, and we invite you to join our Discord channel for further discussion.

Political Mastery
Powehi Games

notes.title: Weekly Development Diary 1
notes.content:
As the Political Mastery team, we have decided to provide a more detailed explanation of our game and share our weekly activities as we progress with your ideas.

This week, our team has introduced an "event" system to the game, enhancing the overall game progression with dynamic elements. In this game, players must make spontaneous decisions at the start of each turn, involving world events, journalist inquiries, natural disasters, party intrigues, agendas, and ideological contradictions. These choices will directly impact the player's standing with the party leader, stress levels, finances, and voter support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44475061/8cce08b645da97379275c922f28bffd3f2bd2fb4.jpg[/img]

To further enrich the event system, we aim to mold character traits based on the player's decisions. For instance, if a player copes with stress by opting to smoke a cigarette during a stress event, they will temporarily alleviate stress but gain the "smoker" trait for their character. We will delve deeper into the development of character traits in a forthcoming dev diary.

As the Powehi Games and Political Mastery development team, we eagerly seek your input and ideas. Please share your thoughts by commenting on this platform, and feel free to join our Discord channel for discussions. You are also invited to play our upcoming demo for free. Thank you for your invaluable support.
